subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

In the figure, line $m$ is parallel to line $n$, and line $l$ intersects both lines. Which of the following pairs are alternate interior angles?
explanation: Alternate interior angles are pairs of angles on opposite sides of the transversal and between the parallel lines. Angle 1 is at the upper intersection (point P on line $m$) on the left side of line $l$, and angle 5 is at the lower intersection (point Q on line $n$) on the right side of line $l$. Both lie between the parallel lines and on opposite sides of the transversal, so they are alternate interior angles.
